entries.description: Visual product-matching for shopping. Give it a product as a URL, an image, or a text description and it returns visually similar products ("dupes") sold by other retailers, usually cheaper, with prices and buy links. Coverage is strongest in furniture, home decor, fashion, footwear, bags and beauty. Free to use; revenue comes from affiliate commissions at no extra cost to the shopper.
representativeQueries: find a cheaper version of this sofa
what does a dupe of this designer bag cost
this lamp is sold out, what looks like it
recreate this living room for less
is this the best price for this chair

data.name: dupe-mcp
data.description: Dupe.com product search over the Model Context Protocol. Prefer search_products_by_url or search_products_by_image when the user has a link or a picture; text search is the weakest of the three.

tools.name: search_products_by_url
tools.description: Best-fit entry point. Takes a full product page URL, extracts the product, and returns visually similar alternatives.

tools.name: search_products_by_image
tools.description: Takes a publicly reachable image URL and returns visually similar products. Use for screenshots, photos and inspiration images.

tools.name: search_products_by_text
tools.description: Takes a keyword or description query with an optional shopping category. Weakest of the three; prefer a URL or image when the user has one.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Fetches enriched detail (description, brand, specifications, images, typical price range) for up to 5 product_id values from a previous search. Requires an API key.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol alias for text product search, named per the /.well-known/ucp shopping profile.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol alias for finding alternatives to one or more product page URLs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol alias for enriched single-product detail by ID. Requires an API key.

entries.description: How to use Dupe.com as an agent: when it is the right tool and when it is not, how to call the MCP server, how to present prices and matches honestly, and what governs automated access.

how should an agent quote dupe.com prices and retailers
